bounds: one pool of capacity 1 over three unit intervals with two overlapping offers; one subcontract (prefund 12, price 10); one export of 20 split 13/7; one mission with monotone generations; sequences of length <= 6 over 26 events; not an unbounded proof
assumptions: the authority is honest and its database is durable between steps
messages may be delayed, duplicated or reordered but not forged
a crash inside a transaction leaves no partial durable state
amounts are small integers of one asset
invariants: conservation: available + reserved + backing equals the fixture
claims backed: lots plus in-transit retirements never exceed locked backing
pool within capacity at every unit interval
subcontract payments plus returns never exceed the prefund
lot partition: lots + returned + in transit equals the allocation amount
exactly one active generation once fenced
